trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[pf:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team) WHERE p.olympic_gold_medals = '0' AND p.position <> 'Backcourt' AND t.founded_year <> '1989' RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team) WHERE p.current_team = t.team_name AND p.olympic_gold_medals = '0' AND p.position <> 'Backcourt' AND t.founded_year <> '1989' RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2
